newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Car sales of Philippine assemblers up 23.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Car sales of Philippine assemblers up 23.5 pct.

text.p: Car sales of the Philippines' four largest assemblers jumped 23.5 percent to 44,140 units in the first eight months of the year, Honda Cars Philippines Inc said.
It quoted an initial report by the Chamber of the Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines as saying the sales of the four firms during the same period in 1995 were 35,746 units.
The report cited by Honda in a news release on Saturday also said it is yet to consolidate reports from all car assemblers.
Sales of Honda, a unit of Honda Motor Ltd Co, totalled 13,704 units in the first eight months of 1996, up 75 percent from 7,830 cars a year ago.
Sales of Toyota Motor Phils Corp jumped 15.7 percent to 12,968 units from 11,205, while Mitsubishi Motors Philippines sold 9,460 units, up from 7,793.
Nissan Motor Phils Inc posted a 10.2 percent drop in sales to 8,008 units from 8,918.
